title: 🔥 CALVINISM VS. ARMINIANISM—WHO’S RIGHT? WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 CALVINISM VS. ARMINIANISM—WHO’S RIGHT? WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY? 🔥
💬 "Brother John, I keep hearing about Calvinism and Arminianism. Some say we have no free will and God chooses who goes to heaven or hell. Others say we have a choice. What does the Bible actually say?"

🚨 THIS DEBATE HAS DIVIDED CHRISTIANS FOR CENTURIES! Calvinists believe God predestines everything, even who gets saved. Arminians believe humans have free will to accept or reject salvation. But what does the BIBLE really teach?
📖 Key Verse: "Choose this day whom you will serve." (Joshua 24:15)
🔥 DO YOU HAVE FREE WILL, OR IS EVERYTHING PRE-DECIDED? LET’S FIND OUT! 🔥

🔥 1. WHAT IS CALVINISM? THE FIVE-POINT SYSTEM (T.U.L.I.P.)
📖 Ephesians 1:4-5 – "He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world."
💡 CALVINISM TEACHES THAT GOD PREDESTINES EVERYTHING, INCLUDING SALVATION.

✅ T – TOTAL DEPRAVITY → Man is so sinful, he cannot even choose God.
✅ U – UNCONDITIONAL ELECTION → God chooses who will be saved & who will go to hell.
✅ L – LIMITED ATONEMENT → Jesus only died for the elect (those chosen by God).
✅ I – IRRESISTIBLE GRACE → If God chooses you, you cannot resist salvation.
✅ P – PERSEVERANCE OF THE SAINTS → If you’re saved, you cannot lose salvation.
🚨 THE PROBLEM? This removes human free will and makes God the author of sin and damnation!

🔥 2. WHAT IS ARMINIANISM? THE FIVE COUNTERPOINTS
📖 1 Timothy 2:4 – "God desires all people to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth."
💡 ARMINIANISM TEACHES THAT GOD GAVE HUMANS FREE WILL TO CHOOSE SALVATION.

✅ 1. FREE WILL → Man is sinful but still able to choose or reject God.
✅ 2. CONDITIONAL ELECTION → God foreknows who will believe, but does not force them.
✅ 3. UNLIMITED ATONEMENT → Jesus died for everyone, not just the elect.
✅ 4. RESISTIBLE GRACE → You can reject God’s salvation.
✅ 5. CONDITIONAL SECURITY → You can fall away if you reject Christ later.
🚨 THE PROBLEM? If salvation is fully up to man’s choice, where does God’s sovereignty fit in?

🔥 3. WHAT DOES THE BIBLE ACTUALLY SAY?
📖 2 Peter 3:9 – "The Lord is not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance."
💡 THE TRUTH IS IN THE MIDDLE! GOD IS SOVEREIGN, BUT HE GIVES US FREE WILL!

✔️ GOD DESIRES ALL TO BE SAVED – He does not pick and choose who goes to hell. (1 Timothy 2:4)
✔️ JESUS DIED FOR EVERYONE, NOT JUST A FEW! (John 3:16)
✔️ SALVATION IS A CHOICE – We must repent and believe. (Acts 17:30)
✔️ GOD FOREKNOWS WHO WILL CHOOSE HIM – But He does not force them. (Romans 8:29)
✔️ SALVATION CAN BE REJECTED – You can resist the Holy Spirit. (Acts 7:51)
🚨 THE BIBLE NEVER TEACHES THAT GOD FORCES PEOPLE TO HEAVEN OR HELL!

🔥 4. IF WE HAVE FREE WILL, DOES THAT MEAN GOD ISN’T IN CONTROL?
📖 Proverbs 16:9 – "The heart of man plans his way, but the Lord establishes his steps."
💡 GOD IS 100% IN CONTROL—BUT HE ALLOWS CHOICES!

✔️ GOD CONTROLS HISTORY, PROPHECY, AND THE FUTURE.
✔️ GOD ALLOWS FREE WILL BECAUSE LOVE MUST BE A CHOICE.
✔️ GOD’S PLAN WILL BE FULFILLED, BUT HUMANS ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR THEIR ACTIONS.
🚨 GOD DOESN’T WANT ROBOTS—HE WANTS REAL, WILLING LOVE!

🔥 5. CAN YOU LOSE YOUR SALVATION? OR IS IT GUARANTEED FOREVER?
📖 Hebrews 6:4-6 – "It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened... if they fall away, to be brought back to repentance."
💡 THE BIBLE TEACHES THAT TRUE SALVATION IS SECURE—BUT A PERSON CAN STILL FALL AWAY!

✔️ SALVATION IS SECURE IN CHRIST – No one can take us out of God’s hand. (John 10:28)
✔️ BUT FAITH MUST ENDURE UNTIL THE END! – "He who endures to the end will be saved." (Matthew 24:13)
✔️ SOME WILL ABANDON THE FAITH – They were once saved but later rejected Christ. (1 Timothy 4:1)
🚨 ETERNAL SECURITY IS REAL, BUT IT REQUIRES CONTINUED FAITH IN JESUS!

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I BELIEVE IN GOD’S SOVEREIGNTY AND THE FREE WILL HE GAVE ME! I CHOOSE TO FOLLOW JESUS DAILY!"

🔥 THE BIBLICAL TRUTH CHALLENGE!
✅ Step 1: Read the Bible yourself—don’t just follow human theology!
✅ Step 2: Pray for wisdom—ask God for His understanding!
🔥 #FreeWillVsPredestination #BiblicalTruth #CalvinismVsArminianism #ChooseWisely #GospelWarrior #JohnXAsis
